shots.why: intact and recorded: a boy in a staged 1951 room lifts a chair across to the window. Locked-off, so every pixel behind him can be found elsewhere in the shot.

shots.title: derived, person removed (Speaking of Rubber, 1951)
shots.why: return to the same seconds, person removed, same sound. The chair goes on its own. Replacement pixels come from this same shot; see erase/removal.json.

shots.title: derived, person removed (Speaking of Rubber, 1951)
shots.why: the aftermath, held for its whole length. What he did for the next seventeen seconds is gone and his film's sound continues.

shots.title: recorded beside derived
shots.caption:
Left: recorded, 1951. Right: person removed by this film.
The room was never empty.

shots.title: the mask
shots.caption:
The mask. Each pixel under it is replaced by the same
pixel from moments when he stood elsewhere in this shot.
